codeOnlyTokens.sticker-edge: Sticker avatar's paper and ink, white and near-black in both themes. Sticker avatar has no Figma component yet; add both with it.
codeOnlyTokens.sticker-ink: Sticker avatar's paper and ink, white and near-black in both themes. Sticker avatar has no Figma component yet; add both with it.

figmaOnlyProps.Avatar.type: Code picks image or initials from whether src loads; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Checkbox.checked: Base UI's checked and indeterminate props, not a fibo prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.view: Which page is open is internal state in code.
figmaOnlyProps.Command menu.preview: Code shows the pane when an item has preview content; Figma toggles it.
figmaOnlyProps.Typing indicator.indicator: Code shows a person's indicator from data when they're the only one typing; designers pick it by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Message.type: Code picks first, continuation, system or deleted from grouping rules and message data, not a prop.
figmaOnlyProps.Message divider.unread: Code draws the unread divider above the message named by unreadFrom.
figmaOnlyProps.Data table.selection: In code the selection is state, from value or defaultValue; Figma shows each state as a variant.
figmaOnlyProps.Data table.width: Code reads the container's width and switches at 32rem; Figma picks narrow by hand.
figmaOnlyProps.Data table.narrowLayout: Not in code yet: the narrow layouts are phase 4 of plans/003-data-table.md.

codeOnlyProps.reactions.position: Which viewport corner the floating bar pins to; Figma shows the bar on its own.
